name: Citizenship by Residence (1952 Transitional Provision, Former Palestinian Citizens)

qualifying_event.description: A former citizen of Mandatory Palestine who was a registered inhabitant of Israel on 1 March 1952, remained continuously in Israeli territory (or was legally absent) since the establishment of the State, and held resident status when the Nationality Law took effect, automatically acquired Israeli nationality by residence under Section 3 of the Nationality Law 5712-1952.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Historical registration and residency records from 1948-1952 -- this is a one-time transitional provision, not an ongoing application route.

requirements.blocker_text: Was a registered inhabitant of Israel on 1 March 1952.
Remained continuously in Israeli territory (or was legally absent) from the establishment of the State until the law's effective date.

sources.title: fs.knesset.gov.il (the Knesset, Israel's Parliament -- official primary legislation archive) -- Nationality Law 5712-1952, Section 3 (Hebrew): citizenship by residence for a pre-statehood Palestine resident who was registered as a resident by 1 March 1952, remained resident on the law's effective date, and remained in/lawfully entered Israel between 1948 and 1952; children born after 1948 to a qualifying parent also acquire citizenship
